title: Riemann Hypothesis
subtitle: Unsolved problem
summary: All non-trivial zeros of ζ(s) lie on Re(s)=½. Clay Millennium Prize Problem.
detail:
Proposed by Riemann (1859). Over 10 trillion non-trivial zeros verified — all on Re(s)=½. No proof exists.

\[\zeta(s)=\sum_{n=1}^\infty\frac{1}{n^s},\quad\text{all non-trivial zeros satisfy }\operatorname{Re}(s)=\tfrac{1}{2}\]

A proof would imply optimal error bounds in the prime number theorem.
